name: Frontier Gauntlet
description: The hardest tier, built to separate the very best models once they saturate Core: extreme logic grids and truth-teller puzzles, olympiad maths, long-horizon planning, frontier coding, contract-grade data extraction, adversarial system prompts, high-pressure honesty traps and the hard variants of every simulation. Expect small models to score near zero here. Use 3 repeats for published results.
